description: Deploy given repository URL / revision to dest. If dest exists, update to the specified revision, otherwise perform a checkout.

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: If false, do not check out the repository if it does not exist locally. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Absolute path where the repository should be deployed. The destination directory must be specified unless checkout=no, update=no, and export=no.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Path to svn executable to use. If not supplied, the normal mechanism for resolving binary paths will be used.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: If true, do export instead of checkout/update. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If true, modified files will be discarded. If false, module will fail if it encounters modified files. Prior to 1.9 the default was true. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: in_place
parameters.description: If the directory exists, then the working copy will be checked-out over-the-top using svn checkout --force; if force is specified then existing files with different content are reverted. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: --password parameter passed to svn when svn is less than version 1.10.0. This is not secure and the password will be leaked to argv. --password-from-stdin parameter when svn is greater or equal to version 1.10.0.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: The subversion URL to the repository.

parameters.name: switch
parameters.description: If false, do not call svn switch before update. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: update
parameters.description: If false, do not retrieve new revisions from the origin repository. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, passes the --trust-server-cert flag to svn. If true, does not pass the flag. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Checkout subversion repository to specified folder
  ansible.builtin.subversion:
    repo: svn+ssh://an.example.org/path/to/repo
    dest: /src/checkout

- name: Export subversion directory to folder
  ansible.builtin.subversion:
    repo: svn+ssh://an.example.org/path/to/repo
    dest: /src/export
    export: yes

- name: Get information about the repository whether or not it has already been cloned locally
  ansible.builtin.subversion:
    repo: svn+ssh://an.example.org/path/to/repo
    dest: /src/checkout
    checkout: no
    update: no
